blocks.text:
The adjustable widgets can be roughly divided into those which use and
require specific units for these values, and those which treat them as
arbitrary numbers.
blocks.zh: 可调整部件大致可以分为使用并要求这些值使用特定单位的和将它们视作任意数字的。

blocks.text:
The group which treats the values as arbitrary numbers includes the
`Range` widgets (`Scrollbar` and
`Scale`), the `ScaleButton` widget,
and the `SpinButton` widget. These widgets  are typically
"adjusted" directly by the user with the mouse or keyboard. They will treat the
`lower` and `upper` values of an
adjustment as a range within which the user can manipulate the adjustment's
`value`. By default, they will only modify the
`value` of an adjustment.

The other group includes the `Viewport` widget and the
`ScrolledWindow` widget. All of these widgets use pixel
values for their adjustments. These are also typically adjusted indirectly
using scrollbars. While all widgets which use adjustments can either create
their own adjustments or use ones you supply, you'll generally want to let this
particular category of widgets create its own adjustments.
blocks.zh: 另一组部件包括Viewport和ScrolledWindow。所有的这些部件都将调整的值视作像素值。通常你也可以使用滚动条间接的修改调整的值。虽然所有使用调整的部件都可以创建自己的调整也可以使用你提供的调整，但是通常情况下你都会希望使用这些部件自行创建的调整。
